decision: No grouped-grammar dispatcher integration: all measured tiers miss the predeclared long-run coverage gate; executable emulator source is unchanged.

method.command: XV6_LEAN=1 XV6_RAM_HASH=1 XV6_NATIVE_DISPATCH=1 XV6_FIRMWARE=bochs XV6_STEPS=40000000 XV6_STOP_ON_EXPECT=1 XV6_COMMAND=$'forktest\r' XV6_EXPECT_SERIAL=$'fork test OK\n$ ' node --import ./scripts/observe-i80386-dynamic-span-potential.mjs scripts/probe-xv6-stock.mjs
method.comparison: Repeat the command without --import ./scripts/observe-i80386-dynamic-span-potential.mjs and compare stdout byte-for-byte. The observer writes its single DYNAMIC_SPAN_POTENTIAL JSON line to stderr at process exit.
method.denominator: 6,379,836 completed protected32 ordinary-JS fallback _stepInstruction calls in the opt-in native-dispatch xv6 run, among 24,338,279 total guest steps. Existing native-block retirements are excluded from the fallback span census.
method.counting: Fetched instruction bytes are captured only during ordinary _stepInstruction, after a completed-step cycle check. A run continues only across selected forms with contiguous CS:EIP and cycles. No guest decode-ahead, data access, page walk, or execution change is introduced.
method.priorCensusContrast: docs/receipts/2026-09-28-i80386-selected-forms-potential.json counted 22,808,047 protected32 completed ordinary steps on an earlier source without this native-dispatch fallback denominator. Its linked-run potential cannot be substituted for these 6,379,836 current-source fallback retirements.
method.limits: These counts are syntax-only observational upper bounds, not native eligibility or speed estimates. They do not prove segment/paging A-D, fault, MMIO, code-write, privilege, or chip/LAPIC event safety. EIP discontinuity includes control transfer and possible intervening native work; the observer does not attribute it more narrowly.

fixture.workload: Lean stock xv6 forktest; Bochs firmware; 40M step cap; stop on expected serial

gate.result: fail for every tier; broadest tier is 298,330 steps below the long-run minimum

tiers.name: narrow
tiers.grammar: Exact standalone-spike 8B/89 two-byte mod00 non-SIB non-disp form

tiers.name: memoryAluBranch
tiers.grammar: 8B/89 memory addressing plus 8D, common ALU/compare/test, selected 81/83 immediate groups, 25/A8/90/B8..BF, short and near Jcc

tiers.name: plusStackControl
tiers.grammar: memoryAluBranch plus push/pop, near call/jump/return, leave, FF /2,/4,/6 and 8F /0

tiers.name: plusByteString
tiers.grammar: plusStackControl plus F6 /0 TEST byte, A4 MOVSB, and 0F B6/B7 MOVZX

nextDesign: Change the entry-cost model before expanding another opcode tier: test a cheap short-span resume or a dynamic multi-page trace that retains native state across ordinary RAM operations and slow-exits before faultable/MMIO/event boundaries. The standalone dynamic-memory contract has no production dispatcher wiring; stack/control and byte/string inclusion would add substantial proof burden. Require a new measured cost/coverage gate, full guest/RAM parity, and paired user-CPU A/B before a speed claim.
